scope: English second tier: Football League Second Division (1892-93 to 1991-92), Football League First Division (1992-93 to 2003-04), Championship (2004-05 onward)
source: https://www.rsssf.org/engpaul/FLA/ (season final tables 1888-89 to 2007-08: third place, points, cross-check)

fieldNotes.footsimuId: ESPN team id (the id FootSimu uses); null when the club is not in FootSimu/ESPN English data
fieldNotes.footsimuPath: club page path under the league the club plays in now (2026-27), without locale
fieldNotes.points: final points after deductions (2 points per win until 1980-81, 3 from 1981-82)
fieldNotes.name: club name used that season
fieldNotes.tournament: "North"/"South" for the regional Third Division sections, otherwise null
